_published_faq.name: How do I add AutoMotion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AutoMotion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://automotion-mcp-production-6f08e98a6e4b.herokuapp.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is AutoMotion MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, AutoMotion scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AutoMotion MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AutoMotion provides these MCP tools: find_locations, get_booking_details, and list_brands.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AutoMotion?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AutoMotion in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
AutoMotion does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
AutoMotion is developed by AutoMotion Mobility. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
